description: End-to-end Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) workflow from tenant onboarding and network provisioning through usage metering, rating, invoicing, and payment handling.

tenant_id.description: Unique identifier for a tenant (customer/account) consuming NaaS services.

subscription_id.description: Identifier for a subscription that groups one or more NaaS services and associated commercial terms.

service_id.description: Identifier for a provisioned NaaS service instance (e.g., VPN, dedicated link, virtual router).

usage_session_id.description: Identifier for a logical metering session (e.g., flow, tunnel, link usage window).

payment_id.description: Identifier for a processed or pending payment.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

audit_event_id.description: Identifier of an audit log entry.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of a captured state snapshot.

functions.name: create_tenant_and_subscription
functions.description: Create a new tenant and an initial NaaS subscription with commercial terms and default policies.

tenant_profile.description: Basic identification and contact information for the tenant.

name.description: Legal or trading name of the tenant.

subscription.description: Initial subscription configuration, including commercial model and allowed services.

plan_id.description: Identifier of a pre-defined commercial plan.

override_terms.description: Optional overrides for standard plan terms.

allowed_service_types.description: Which NaaS service classes the tenant is allowed to provision under this subscription.

usage_policies.description: High-level usage limits and throttling parameters.

tags.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs for labeling (e.g., vertical, region).

functions.returns: Tenant ID and created subscription ID with initial status.

functions.name: provision_naas_service
functions.description: Provision a new NaaS service instance (e.g., VPN, dedicated link) under an existing subscription.

service_type.description: Type of NaaS service to provision.

topology.description: Service topology definition, varying slightly by service type.

endpoints.description: Logical endpoints participating in the service.

region_code.description: Region or metro code (e.g., us-east-1, eu-west).

billing_model.description: How usage will be monetized for this service.

start_time.description: Requested activation time; immediate if omitted.

functions.returns: Service ID, provisioning status, and initial configuration summary.

functions.name: get_service_status
functions.description: Retrieve current status, health, and recent events for a NaaS service.

include.description: Optional additional information to include in the response.

functions.returns: Current operational status, health indicators, and optionally topology and billing summaries.

functions.name: record_usage_batch
functions.description: Ingest a batch of raw usage records for one or more services and usage sessions for later rating.

batch_id.description: External batch identifier for idempotency and reconciliation.

classification.description: Logical classification of this traffic for rating/prioritization.

application.description: Optional application label (e.g., VoIP, video, backup).

source.description: Information about the metering system providing the records.

ingest_mode.description: Append new records or upsert by usage_session_id+timestamp.

functions.returns: Batch ingest acknowledgment with accepted count, rejected count, and any validation errors.

functions.name: rate_usage_sessions
functions.description: Transform raw usage sessions into rated charges based on subscription and service pricing rules.

time_window.description: Time range of usage sessions to rate.

filter.description: Optional filters to limit rated sessions.

preview_mode.description: If true, calculate charges without persisting them.

functions.returns: Summary of rated sessions including aggregate quantities and monetary amounts, with optional preview flag.

functions.name: generate_invoice
functions.description: Generate an invoice from rated usage and recurring charges for a billing period.

billing_period.description: Billing period to generate an invoice for.

consolidate_services.description: Whether to group charges by service type instead of individual service.

tax_profile.description: Override default tax profile if needed.

dry_run.description: If true, simulate invoice creation without persisting it.

functions.returns: Invoice ID (if not dry run), invoice totals, line item summary, and tax breakdown.

functions.name: get_invoice_details
functions.description: Retrieve invoice details including line items, usage breakdown, and payment status.

include.description: Optional additional sections to include in the response.

functions.returns: Full invoice object with requested sections and current payment/collection status.

functions.name: list_invoices
functions.description: List invoices for a tenant with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

filters.description: Filters to apply to the invoice list.

functions.returns: Paginated list of invoices matching the filters, including counts and pagination cursors.

functions.name: apply_invoice_adjustment
functions.description: Apply a credit, debit, or dispute adjustment to an existing invoice.

adjustment.description: Details of the adjustment being applied.

auto_recalculate.description: Recalculate tax and totals after applying the adjustment.

functions.returns: Updated invoice summary including new totals, status, and recorded adjustment entry.

functions.name: initiate_payment
functions.description: Initiate a payment against one or more invoices using a chosen payment method.

payment_request.description: Payment request details, including invoices to settle and payment instrument.

invoices.description: List of invoice allocations to be paid in this transaction.

payment_method.description: Payment instrument information; shape depends on method_type.

token.description: Tokenized card reference from a PCI-compliant vault.

bank_transfer.description: Bank transfer details for non-card payments.

reference.description: Unique payment reference to be quoted by payer.

wallet.description: Digital wallet details (e.g., PayPal, internal credit).

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to safely retry payment initiations.

functions.returns: Payment ID, initial payment status, and any redirection or reference information required to complete the payment.

functions.name: retry_or_cancel_payment
functions.description: Retry a failed payment attempt or cancel an authorized but not captured payment.

retry_options.description: Options for retrying a payment (only used when action is retry).

new_payment_method.description: Optional alternative payment method to use for the retry.

reference.description: Generic reference/token for the new payment method.

reason.description: Reason for retry (e.g., updated card, resolved risk check).

cancel_reason.description: Reason for canceling the payment (required for cancel action).

functions.returns: Updated payment status, along with any follow-up required (e.g., new authorization needed).

functions.name: suspend_or_rollback_services_for_nonpayment
functions.description: Suspend active NaaS services or rollback recent activations for a tenant due to nonpayment or collection issues.

policy.description: Enforcement policy describing what actions to perform.

throttle_profile.description: Throttle parameters when action_type is throttle.

rollback_lookback_days.description: Number of days to look back for recent activations to rollback.

effective_from.description: When the enforcement becomes effective; immediate if omitted.

notification.description: Tenant notification preferences for this enforcement.

functions.returns: Summary of services impacted, actions taken or scheduled, and notification status.

functions.name: restore_services_after_payment
functions.description: Restore previously suspended or throttled NaaS services after successful payment or resolution.

restore_policy.description: Controls which services to restore and how.

restore_bandwidth_profile.description: Whether to restore original bandwidth profiles before throttling/suspension.

effective_from.description: When restoration should take effect; immediate if omitted.

functions.returns: List of services restored, any that failed to restore, and updated operational states.

functions.name: search_tenants
functions.description: Faceted search across tenant records with rich filters, full-text query, and faceted aggregations for naas_usage_to_payment.

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

highlight.description: Return highlighted snippets when matching text

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated result set of tenant records with facet buckets, total count, and continuation cursor.

functions.name: list_tenants_by_status
functions.description: List tenant records filtered by lifecycle status with stable cursor pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated list of tenant records matching the requested statuses, optionally with summary metrics.

functions.name: get_tenant_detail
functions.description: Fetch a single tenant record with optional expansion of related entities and versioned snapshots.

as_of.description: Read the record as of this point in time

version_id.description: Specific version to retrieve when versioning is enabled

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A tenant record with the requested expansions and version metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_tenants
functions.description: Submit a batch of tenant records for creation, with idempotency keys and partial-success reporting.

tags.description: Tags applied to the new record

trace_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the batch

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A per-item outcome list with created identifiers, validation errors, and batch-level statistics.

functions.name: bulk_update_tenants
functions.description: Apply partial updates to many tenant records in a single transactional batch.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

patch.description: JSON merge-patch applied to every matched record

dry_run.description: Compute affected count without applying changes

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Affected record count, sampled previews, and any per-record errors.

functions.name: bulk_archive_tenants
functions.description: Soft-archive tenant records matching a selector with optional grace period before purge.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

preserve_audit.description: Keep audit trail even after purge

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Archive operation summary including matched count, scheduled purge date, and any blockers.

functions.name: export_tenants
functions.description: Asynchronously export a filtered slice of tenant records to the configured object store.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

destination.description: Where the export should be delivered

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with status, destination URI, and progress callbacks.

functions.name: subscribe_tenant_events
functions.description: Register a webhook subscription for tenant lifecycle events with HMAC signing and replay protection.

filter.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

signing_secret_ref.description: Reference to the HMAC signing secret

tls_verify.description: Whether to validate the server certificate

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A subscription handle including subscription_id, verification status, and current delivery health.

functions.name: unsubscribe_tenant_events
functions.description: Disable or delete a previously created tenant event subscription.

drain_seconds.description: Grace period to flush in-flight events

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Final subscription state and any undelivered event counts at the time of termination.

functions.name: get_tenant_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the chronological audit log for a tenant including who changed what and when.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An ordered list of audit entries with diffs, actor metadata, and correlation ids.

functions.name: query_tenant_changelog
functions.description: Query the cross-record changelog for naas_usage_to_payment with field-level filters.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

fields_changed.description: Restrict to changes touching these fields

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregated changelog rows or detail entries depending on group_by, plus totals.

functions.name: schedule_tenant_job
functions.description: Create a recurring or one-off scheduled job that runs a naas_usage_to_payment operation.

operation.description: Operation name to invoke when the schedule fires

input_template.description: Parameters passed to the operation, with templating

failure_policy.description: What to do when a run fails

max_failures.description: Pause schedule after this many failures

alert_channel.description: Channel id to alert on failure

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A schedule descriptor including schedule_id, next run time, and validation issues.

functions.name: pause_tenant_schedule
functions.description: Temporarily pause a scheduled naas_usage_to_payment job without deleting its history.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated schedule status and prior pause history.

functions.name: simulate_tenant_execution
functions.description: Run a dry-run simulation of a naas_usage_to_payment execution path without producing side effects.

include_side_effect_plan.description: Return the side effects that would have been emitted

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Simulation transcript with predicted outcome, side-effect plan, and assertions checked.

functions.name: preview_tenant_change
functions.description: Compute a preview of how a proposed change would affect a tenant prior to commit.

evaluate_policies.description: Run policy engine against the proposed state

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A preview document with field diffs, policy verdicts, and dependency impact.

functions.name: submit_tenant_for_approval
functions.description: Submit a tenant for review with configurable approver routing and SLA targets.

approver_group.description: Group or role authorised at this step

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Approval workflow handle with approval_id, current step, and projected completion time.

functions.name: record_tenant_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/recuse decision for a pending tenant approval step.

conditions.description: Conditions attached to a conditional approval

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated approval state, next pending step, and any triggered automations.

functions.name: escalate_tenant
functions.description: Escalate a stuck or breached tenant to a higher tier with paging and audit.

target_team.description: Team or rota receiving the escalation

context_refs.description: Related artifact ids attached for context

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Escalation record id, paged responders, and acknowledgement timer.

functions.name: add_tenant_comment
functions.description: Append a comment, optionally with @mentions and visibility scope, to a tenant.

mentions.description: User ids mentioned in the body

parent_comment_id.description: Comment id this one replies to

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Newly created comment record including comment_id and resolved mentions.

functions.name: attach_tenant_evidence
functions.description: Upload an evidence file or link as an attachment to a tenant with content hash and retention.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Attachment descriptor including attachment_id, content hash, and stored URI.

functions.name: snapshot_tenant_state
functions.description: Capture a point-in-time snapshot of a tenant and its dependencies for restore or audit.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, captured size, and storage URI.

functions.name: restore_tenant_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a tenant (and optionally dependencies) from a previously captured snapshot.

new_owner_id.description: Owner of the restored record when mode=new_record

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Restore job descriptor with conflicts surfaced and final record id.

functions.name: get_tenant_metrics_summary
functions.description: Compute summary KPIs for naas_usage_to_payment over a time window with optional segmentation.

metrics.description: Metric names to compute (e.g. throughput, p95_latency, failure_rate)

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

compare_to_previous_period.description: Include delta vs the previous equal-length window

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A metrics document with per-bucket values, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: create_tenant_dashboard
functions.description: Define a dashboard layout combining charts and tables for naas_usage_to_payment.

query.description: Query spec, polymorphic by panel type

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Dashboard descriptor including dashboard_id and resolved share list.

functions.name: define_tenant_policy
functions.description: Create or version a policy controlling allowed naas_usage_to_payment behaviour.

rules.description: Ordered rule list, first match wins

when.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

enforcement_mode.description: How strictly the policy is applied

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Policy version descriptor with policy_id, version_id, and validation report.

functions.name: evaluate_tenant_policies
functions.description: Evaluate the active naas_usage_to_payment policies against a candidate input and return verdicts.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregate verdict, per-rule outcomes, and any obligations attached to the decision.

functions.name: link_tenant_dependencies
functions.description: Declare typed dependency links between a tenant and related artifacts to drive impact analysis.

replace_existing.description: Replace prior links of the same relations

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Resulting link set with created, updated, and removed entries.
